referenceTitle: THIS WORLD HAS ALREADY BEEN RENDERED
logoPolicy: Only body logos within main use the first landing responsive width and original image ratio. The shared footer retains its frozen original /archive geometry.
scope: First landing aliases retain brand size/position and native typography. The first hero moves copy/CTA to halve the brand-to-title gap and reduce Logic-to-CTA spacing by one third. Other main-page editorial headings and large paragraphs use the reference title size; narrative paragraphs and list items use the reference body size. Fonts, labels, controls, navigation, equations, code and tables retain their own treatment.

editorialWordmarkException.rule: Retain original three word crops and native CERN editorial panel geometry. Exclude from horizontal home-logo normalization.

footerException.rule: Footer is frozen at approved original shared-footer geometry and type. All body logo, typography, readability and layout normalization must exclude footer.

sectionEntrances.rule: Full first-landing body wordmark width and original ratio; section names use the existing landing title size. No compact logo or independently enlarged section-name scale.
sectionEntrances.spacing: Mobile entrances match the approved APPLY grid and typography; no arbitrary translate lifts. Desktop remains at approved landing-rhythm layout. Preserve main/APPLY and all footers.

landingSpacing.rule: Preserve brand geometry, native grid, DOM order and text sizes. Lift title/Logic copy together; lift SEE MORE/VOIR PLUS by the same amount plus one third of its original gap from Logic. Recover unshifted gaps before every resize measurement.
